messages:
Anne (CS): Quick note 1 1: we've been hitting a steady trickle of feature asks and onboarding blockers in calls; threads are getting lost. Can we formalize a 1-minute capture that feeds product?

Leo (PM): Agree. Short, structured capture would help. Prefer something we can paste into a bot that creates a single record.

Maria (Support): Support team can add to our end-of-call template. If it's one paragraph + a couple fields we can reliably fill it out. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Eng): Where would the canonical list live? Engineering wants GitHub for implementation tickets, but PMs want a lightweight staging area (Airtable/Productboard).

Anne (CS): Proposal: use a tiny template (3-5 lines + tags). Post into #product-signals via FeedbackBot which writes to Airtable. Triage weekly. Template example:
```
Customer: <customer name>
Area: <module/area>
Ask: <one-sentence feature or pain>
Why: <customer quote or impact>
Impact: <1-5>
RenewalRisk: <none/low/med/high>
OnboardingStage: <trial/first-week/1mo+>
Reporter: <name + call link>
Tags: <billing, perf, integrations>
Effort: <S/M/L>
Blocking_onboarding: <true/false>
```

Leo (PM): Nice. For triage math, let's compute Score = Impact * (1 + RiskWeight) with weights none=0, low=0.2, med=0.5, high=1.0. Anything Score >= 6 bumps to triage.

Sam (Ops): Add a quick effort bucket (S/M/L) so PMs can balance impact vs. cost during grooming.

Maria (Support): Add a "blocking_onboarding" flag. Many items aren't product work but prevent adoption. We'll only escalate if Impact >= 3 or blocking flag is true.

Jordan (Eng): If it's a reproducible bug, include repro_steps; optional for feature asks. Engineering will only pull items into GitHub when they hit `grooming`. Keep schema minimal.

Anne (CS): Example capture we can paste after calls:
```
Customer: ParkCo
Area: Billing
Ask: Per-route billing toggle to enable route-level pricing overrides
Why: "We cannot model region-based surcharge in the current billing flow, losing $X per month"
Impact: 4
RenewalRisk: med
OnboardingStage: first-week
Reporter: Anne (CS) - recording: https://zoom/recording/abc
Tags: billing, pricing, onboarding
Effort: M
Blocking_onboarding: true
```

Leo (PM): Can we autodetect upcoming renewals (<60d) and auto-tag them? That should prioritize items that could affect revenue.

FeedbackBot: I can. If record contains `renewal_date`, I will tag `renewal:soon` and ping #product-triage.

Sam (Ops): Let's schedule a 15-minute CS signals slot every Tuesday. We triage new captures; anything Score >=6 gets flagged for backlog grooming.

Maria (Support): I'll add a 60-second training to onboarding docs so CS/onboarding know the criteria. We'll only escalate if Impact >=3 or blocking_onboarding=true to avoid noise.

Jordan (Eng): Implementation notes: Airtable will compute Score via formula, single-selects for effort and renewal risk. Engineering subscribes to Productboard when an item moves to `grooming` and then opens a GitHub issue.

Anne (CS): Action items: 1) Maria - update call notes + publish training doc (due EOD Friday). 2) Sam - create recurring Tues 15-min triage (invite triage group). 3) Leo - stand up Airtable and FeedbackBot integration; drop sample link. 4) Jordan - confirm minimal fields for eng handoff. I'll follow up after the first week of captures.

Leo (PM): I'll create the Airtable base and add a sample row with formula fields for Score and a `triage_flag`. Will paste link here when ready. :rocket:

Maria (Support): Draft training doc posted to #cs-ops in 2h.

Sam (Ops): Recurring slot booked and invite sent to triage group.

Jordan (Eng): If you want a sample webhook payload for FeedbackBot, say so and I'll paste it.

Anne (CS): Thanks team. We'll reconvene after one week of usage to adjust thresholds/tags. Closing the loop when Airtable + bot are live.
